variant.author: YuuNoce
variant.description:
ChestDiff reads the visible Free Company chest history, filters rows after a configured date/time, and summarizes deposits and withdrawals by item and player. It only processes rows available from the in-game Free Company Chest Log.

Commands:
/chestdiff - Open ChestDiff.
/chestdiff export - Export a summary CSV.
/chestdiff dump - Export diagnostic raw chest log text to CSV.
/chestdiff help - Show command help.
variant.name: ChestDiff
variant.punchline: Summarize Free Company chest history by item and player.
